data.one_liner: Dart package to remove or replace emojis in text
data.what_it_does: It provides a class that can strip emojis from a string or replace them with a custom string. It also offers string extensions for convenience.
use_when: You need to sanitize user input or display text without emojis
You want to replace emojis with a placeholder or custom string
avoid_when: You need to detect or manipulate emojis beyond removal
You need emoji support for UI rendering
weaknesses: Does not handle complex emoji sequences beyond regex
No support for emoji detection or categorization
